oceania.raft.core: The deck is one piece with the helm. Mine the helm to take the houseboat up
oceania.config.title: Oceania
oceania.config.note: Hosted worlds only. A dedicated server uses its own config file.
oceania.config.spawn.sharks.tooltip: Natural spawning of reef, tiger, bull and great white sharks. Spawn eggs and /summon still work, and sharks already in the world stay.
oceania.config.spawn.whales.tooltip: Natural spawning of whales in deep water. Spawn eggs and /summon still work, and whales already in the world stay.
oceania.config.spawn.giant_squid.tooltip: Natural spawning of the giant squid in the deep. Spawn eggs and /summon still work, and any already in the world stay.
oceania.config.spawn.jellyfish.tooltip: Natural spawning of moon, nettle and crown jellyfish. Spawn eggs and /summon still work, and jellyfish already in the world stay.
oceania.config.spawn.crabs.tooltip: Natural spawning of coconut, reef and king crabs. Spawn eggs and /summon still work, and crabs already in the world stay.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.oceania: One endless ocean: tropical islands, deep trenches, hut villages, sharks and whales, and a houseboat you build on and sail.
